— Mission Statement

Friends of Artsy Fartsy Foundation

Our mission is to ensure accessible, inspiring space for the Artsy Fartsy Creative Laboratory; expand equitable access to the arts through scholarships for high school students and adult learners; and strengthen arts education by delivering high-quality color science professional development for elementary, middle, and high school teachers.

We believe creativity is a powerful catalyst for learning, expression, and community, and we work to nurture it across ages, disciplines, and classrooms.

Follow the Magic

Artsy Fartsy Studio

Creative Laboratory & Starlight Atelier

Artsy Fartsy is an expansive creative studio designed for asking better questions, exploring tactile craftsmanship, and drawing thoughtful insight across artistic disciplines.

Studio Locations

Flagship studio with retreat ateliers in Japan Alps, Morocco, Sierra Nevada, and Andalusian coasts.

Studio Hours & Open Atelier

Tuesday — Sunday: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM
Open Stargazing Atelier on Friday Evenings.

Creative Classes

Workshops for Curious Explorers

Celestial Oil Painting & Glaze

Layering pigments and mineral textures inspired by astronomical charts and night skies.

Tactile Ceramic Sculpting

Hand-building earthenware and stoneware with earthen textures and metallic gold leaf.

Expedition Sketchbook Intensive

Field studies, travel watercolors, and panoramic mountain & coastal perspectives.

The Heartlight Foundation

Empowering Artists, Preserving Craft

The Heartlight Honeybee Foundation provides studio residencies, materials grants, and community workshops for emerging artists and craftspeople worldwide.

Global Residency Fellowships

Fully funded 6-week retreat residencies across our partner studios.

Youth Creative Mentorship

Weekly hands-on visual arts education programs for underserved youth communities.

Events & Celebrations

Milestone Birthdays, Private Soirées & Corporate Retreats

Celebrate life’s most cherished moments and inspire your team in our luminous studio atelier. We curate all-inclusive creative events, bespoke private soirées, milestone celebrations, and collaborative corporate experiences tailored to your vision.

Color Magic Birthday Packages

Private studio access, custom color-splatter canvases, dedicated artist host, and personalized favors for all guests.

Private Gatherings & Soirées

Evening cocktail receptions, sunlit arcade luncheons, candlelit art soirées, and bespoke collaborative keepsakes.

Corporate Retreats & Team Building

Guided creative problem solving, collaborative large-scale murals, executive retreats, and festive holiday team celebrations.
